summary: This class models the Printers screen and related printer setup flows for Android mobile automation. It provides comprehensive methods for printer discovery, selection, and setup across different connection types (WiFi, WiFi Direct, Ethernet). The class handles Android version-specific UI differences (Android 7-12+) and includes extensive verification methods for validating screen states. Key patterns include retry logic for element interactions, permission handling, scrolling for element discovery, and timeout management. The class supports both OOBE (out-of-box-experience) printer setup and adding already configured printers, with special handling for WiFi Direct authentication and network selection.
